description: Read one file attached to an issue — its bytes, base64-encoded — by the issue key and the 'filename' as get_issue lists it. The bytes travel as text through the conversation and cost roughly a third more than the file itself, so there is a size ceiling; the pm-files MCP server saves a file to a path instead, without spending the conversation on it (local_files_setup says how to connect it). Reading needs only permission to see the issue.

filename.description: File name, as listed by get_issue.

name: get_attachment
